import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

data = {
    'Year': [2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022],
    'Precision Irrigation': [12.5, 14.0, 16.2, 18.1, 19.8, 21.3, 22.7, 23.5, 24.1, 24.8, 25.2, 25.5, 25.7],
    'Precision Fertilization': [15.2, 17.3, 19.8, 22.1, 24.5, 26.2, 27.8, 28.5, 29.0, 29.7, 30.0, 30.2, 30.4],
    'Organic Soil Treatment': [8.1, 10.3, 12.8, 15.2, 17.5, 19.8, 22.1, 24.0, 25.7, 27.2, 28.0, 28.3, 28.5],
    'Regenerative Cover Crops': [5.3, 7.1, 9.5, 12.0, 15.2, 18.3, 21.1, 23.4, 25.0, 26.3, 27.2, 27.8, 28.5],
    'Conventional Tillage': [-12.0, -14.5, -17.3, -19.8, -21.5, -23.2, -24.0, -24.5, -24.8, -25.0, -25.1, -25.2, -25.3]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)
df_melted = df.melt('Year', var_name='Farming Practice', value_name='Impact (%)')

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.lineplot(
    data=df_melted[df_melted['Farming Practice'] != 'Conventional Tillage'],
    x='Year',
    y='Impact (%)',
    hue='Farming Practice',
    style='Farming Practice',
    markers=True,
    dashes=False,
    palette=['#ff7f0e', '#1f77b4', '#2ca02c', '#9467bd', '#d62728']
)

plt.title('Trends in Impact of Farming Practices Over Time (2010-2022)', fontsize=14, pad=20)
plt.xlabel('Year', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Impact (%)', fontsize=12)
plt.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.7)
plt.legend(title='Farming Practice', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.gca().set_ylim(-28.085, 30.3)
plt.savefig('output.png')

The image is a line chart titled "Trends in Impact of Farming Practices Over Time (2010-2022)," which illustrates the percentage impact of various farming practices from 2010 to 2022. The chart features five distinct lines, each representing a different farming practice, plotted against the horizontal axis labeled "Year" and the vertical axis labeled "Impact (%)". The farming practices included are Precision Irrigation, Precision Fertilization, Organic Soil Treatment, Regenerative Cover Crops, and Conventional Tillage, each differentiated by unique colors and markers.

Precision Irrigation, depicted in blue with circular markers, shows a steady increase in impact from 12.5% in 2010 to 25.7% in 2022. Precision Fertilization, marked in orange with "x" shaped markers, also demonstrates a consistent upward trend, starting at 15.2% in 2010 and reaching 30.4% by 2022. Organic Soil Treatment, shown in green with square markers, rises from 8.1% in 2010 to 28.5% in 2022. Regenerative Cover Crops, represented in purple with triangular markers, begins at 5.3% in 2010 and climbs to 28.5% in 2022. In contrast, Conventional Tillage, indicated by a red line with diamond markers, exhibits a negative trend, declining from -12.0% in 2010 to -25.3% in 2022.

Each line is accompanied by data points for each year, providing precise values for the impact percentages. The grid lines in the background contribute to the readability of the chart, allowing for an easy comparison of the trends over time. The legend positioned outside the plot area clearly identifies each farming practice and its corresponding line style and color. Overall, the chart effectively highlights the increasing adoption and positive impact of modern farming practices while showing the diminishing influence of conventional tillage.

args.message:
The chart contradicted the table and summary, so I fixed four things in chart.py:
- Restored the Conventional Tillage series, which had been filtered out.
- Swapped the first two palette colours so Precision Irrigation is blue and Precision Fertilization is orange.
- Set the markers explicitly to circle, X, square, triangle and diamond to match the summary.
- Removed the hardcoded y-limit of 30.3, which was clipping Fertilization's 30.4 value.

Verified from the figure object:
- The legend lists all five practices.
- Line colours and markers are #1f77b4/o, #ff7f0e/X, #2ca02c/s, #9467bd/^ and #d62728/D, in the summary's order.
- The y-limits are (-28.085, 33.185), so the data range of -25.3 to 30.4 fits.

The rendered output.png shows all five lines, with the legend outside the plot and no overlapping or clipped text. Title, axis labels, grid, legend position and figure size are unchanged.

The only warning was a ResourceWarning from my own unclosed file read, not from the chart.
